evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $48,000,000; attorneys' fees $12,000,000; clear sailing yes; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic

evidence.agent: Ostrander Bell LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: The parties exchanged complete settlement proposals addressing class relief and attorneys’ fees together; they did not first agree on class relief and only later discuss fees.
any amount the court declines to award would be added to the class fund.
Request a meaningful fee that accounts for the firm's investment
Use differentiated offers to test which counsel can resolve the matter most efficiently.
making a substantial counterproposal to resolve the overlapping litigation.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in opening term sheets, and fees were negotiated together with class relief before any class-relief-only agreement was reached. The transcript expressly links fee reductions to increased class recovery through reversion of unawarded fees to the class, and one plaintiff’s private reasoning accounts for its own firm investment. Defense used differentiated offers among overlapping counsel to test who would resolve the matter most efficiently, supporting reverse-auction tactics, but the record does not clearly show plaintiff counsel traded class relief for higher fees or that the court declaration was misleading.
